title: Adapter Conformance Suite
description: Baseline contract conformance checks required by T15 for adapter implementations.
features: Lifecycle hooks: validateConfig(config), init(config) with deterministic config and no direct provider error leak
Health and diagnostics: healthCheck() returns { ok, status } (healthy|degraded|down), diagnostics() returns adapter key/capability metadata
Error normalization: provider errors normalized to AdapterInvocationError with explicit retriable classification
usage: T15A/T15B/T15C/T15D implementations should add fixture-backed tests here and assert conformance lifecycle, capability-specific invocation semantics, and failure normalization. Suite is provider-neutral and should remain stable as new adapters are added.
